title: One cluster id, three member ids
note: `cluster_id` identifies the cluster and is the same in all three answers; `member_id` identifies whoever answered and is different in all three. `raft_index` is how far the log goes and `raft_applied_index` how far the state machine has got; on a quiet cluster the second catches the first, which is why the suite polls rather than comparing them once.

title: The same revision seen twice
note: A revision is a position in one shared log, not a per-member counter. Two members answering the same key with different `mod_revision`s have two different histories, which is the bug this stage exists to catch.
